name: VRM_FMV_TEMPLATES_B_
description: This object stores the processing options for VSOE fair value calculation. The VSOE template is then assigned to items/items groups that inherit the VSOE processing options from the template.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of the template.

columns.name: STRUCTURE_INSTANCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the pricing dimension structure.

columns.name: FMV_PRICE_TYPE
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: FMV_REPRESENTATION_TYPE
columns.description: FMV price representation type. The value is derived from VRM_FMV_REPRESENTATIONS lookup type.

columns.name: DATA_SELECTION_TIME_SPAN
columns.description: Number of coverage periods that a VSOE price calculation process will gather the standalone sales from.

columns.name: MINIMUM_LINE_COUNT
columns.description: Minimum number of standalone sales required in order to calculate a valid VSOE price.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_PCT_RANGE_HIGH
columns.description: Higher limit of the VSOE fair price tolerance range in percentage.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_PCT_RANGE_LOW
columns.description: Lower limit of the VSOE fair price tolerance range in percentage.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_RANGE_COVERAGE
columns.description: The required minimum percentage of standalone sales that its unit selling price falls within tolerance range price of an item.

columns.name: USE_TOLERANCE_FOR_COMPLIANCE
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: DIMENSION_ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Dimension assignment internal identifier.

columns.name: INCLUDE_CURRENT_PERIODS
columns.description: Indicates whether to include sales in current effective price period. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.description: The element type used to identify the nature of item.

columns.name: IN_USE
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is in-used and cannot be deleted. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: FMV_TOLERANCE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the fair market value tolerance range level used to calculate the carve-out adjustment.

columns.name: BELOW_RANGE_SSP_RULE_CODE
columns.description: The rule to be used in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy of the business when the actual value is below the SSP Low Point. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SSP_RANGE_CODE.

columns.name: IN_RANGE_SSP_RULE_CODE
columns.description: The rule to be used in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy of the business when the actual value is between the SSP Low and SSP High Points. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SSP_RANGE_CODE.

columns.name: ABOVE_RANGE_SSP_RULE_CODE
columns.description: The rule to be used in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy of the business when the actual value is above the SSP High Point. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SSP_RANGE_CODE.

columns.name: SSP_RANGE_TOLERANCE_PERCENT
columns.description: The tolerance percentage in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy of the business. The SSP Low Point and SSP High Point are calculated by the application when the SSP tolerance percentage and SSP midpoint are provided for an item or service.
